lines.translation: Você já foi a Lisboa? Estou procurando ideias

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes, I went last year. I took a tram and visited a castle
lines.audioText: Yes, I went last year. I took a tram and visited a castle.
lines.translation: Sim, fui no ano passado. Andei de bonde e visitei um castelo

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: The castle. The view was beautiful, but there were a lot of people

pages.title: Ask about experience with the present perfect
pages.instruction: Use have or has plus a past participle for experience without a finished past date

rows.subject: Experience
rows.example: I’ve been to Lisbon. She has taken a tram

rows.subject: Negative experience
rows.verb: haven’t / hasn’t + participle / have / has never + participle
rows.example: I haven’t visited the aquarium yet. I’ve never been there

rows.subject: Questions and short answers
rows.verb: Have / Has + subject + ever + past participle?
rows.example: Have you ever taken a tram? — Yes, I have / No, I haven’t

rows.subject: The past participle
rows.verb: regular: verb-ed / irregular: learn the form
rows.example: visit → visited; be → been; go → gone; take → taken

pages.note: I/you/we/they have; he/she/it has. Ask for a finished date with past simple: When did you go? — I went last year.

pages.title: Recommend something I’ll enjoy
pages.instruction: Choose an experience, ask about it and give a useful follow-up

pages.title: Listen and answer
pages.instruction: One experience, one plan. Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana! A quick update from Lisbon. I’ve tried a pastel de nata now, and I loved it. I had one at a small café this morning. I haven’t visited the aquarium yet. I’m thinking of going tomorrow, but I haven’t booked a ticket. Have you ever been? I’d love to know what you thought of it before I decide
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana! A quick update from Lisbon. I’ve tried a pastel de nata now, and I loved it. I had one at a small café this morning. I haven’t visited the aquarium yet. I’m thinking of going tomorrow, but I haven’t booked a ticket. Have you ever been? I’d love to know what you thought of it before I decide.
